# PRL Site Solutions

> PRL Site Solutions is a UK construction recruitment agency based in Wirral, Merseyside. We supply CSCS-certified skilled tradesmen, labourers, plant operators, site managers, and Energy-from-Waste (EfW) specialists to construction, industrial, and infrastructure projects across the UK.

## About

PRL Site Solutions Ltd is ISO 9001:2015 certified and Cyber Essentials accredited. We operate a 24-hour rapid response service, placing pre-vetted, compliance-checked workers on site within 24 hours. All operatives are CSCS carded; plant operators hold CPCS or NPORS certification.

Contact: 0800 772 3959 (freephone) | info@prlsitesolutions.co.uk
Address: 15 Beryl Road, Prenton, Wirral CH43 9RS

## Services

- Skilled Trades — electricians, plumbers, carpenters, welders, fabricators
- General Labour — labourers, groundworkers, banksmen
- Plant Operators — CPCS/NPORS certified excavator, crane, and telehandler operators
- Site Management — site managers, supervisors, project coordinators
- Energy-from-Waste (EfW) — QA/QC inspectors, piping engineers, HSE advisors, civils foremen
- Compliance — CSCS, DBS, right-to-work, IR35, and qualification verification via PRISM

## PRISM Contractor Portal

PRISM is our free workforce management app. Contractors submit timesheets, upload compliance documents, and track assignments from their phone. Available at prismworkforce.online.

## Coverage

Northwest England headquarters; nationwide UK deployment. Key locations include Liverpool, Manchester, Wirral, Chester, Warrington, Preston, Lancashire, Deeside, and major EfW/industrial project sites across England and Wales.

## Compliance & Accreditations

- ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management certified
- Cyber Essentials accredited
- Modern Slavery Act 2015 compliant — zero-tolerance policy
- Full IR35 compliance for all contractor engagements
- Drug and alcohol testing programme in operation
